---
title: "3D Prints"
description: "Things I've designed and printed for the lab."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
uploads_src <- here::here("prints_uploads")
uploads_dst <- here::here("docs", "prints_uploads")
if (dir.exists(uploads_src)) {
  dir.create(uploads_dst, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  invisible(file.copy(list.files(uploads_src, full.names = TRUE), uploads_dst,
                        recursive = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE))
}

prints <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here("content", "prints.yml"))

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

render_print <- function(p) {
  photos_html <- if (length(p$photos) > 0) {
    imgs <- paste0(
      '<img src="/', p$photos, '" style="max-width: 260px; max-height: 260px; ',
      'object-fit: cover; margin: 0 8px 8px 0; border-radius: 6px;">'
    )
    paste0('<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap;">', paste(imgs, collapse = "\n"), "</div>\n\n")
  } else ""

  model_html <- if (!is.null(p$model_file)) {
    paste0(
      "[Download ", p$model_filename %||% "model", "](/", p$model_file, "){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}\n\n"
    )
  } else ""

  notes_html <- if (!is.null(p$material_notes) && nzchar(trimws(p$material_notes))) {
    paste0("*", p$material_notes, "*\n\n")
  } else ""

  paste0(
    "\n\n## ", p$title, "\n\n",
    photos_html,
    p$description %||% "", "\n\n",
    notes_html,
    model_html
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (length(prints) == 0) {
  cat("Nothing here yet.\n")
} else {
  cat(paste(vapply(prints, render_print, character(1)), collapse = "\n"))
}
```
